items.description: Itaú Unibanco said it teamed up with tokenization specialist OpenAssets to test tokenized bonds and funds in a pilot run by Brazil's financial watchdog ANBIMA.

items.title: EToro reports second quarter crypto loss even as total profit beats estimates

items.description: The Democrats who may get a bigger say in future crypto legislative efforts are familiar figures, and they generally look at digital assets with distrust.

items.description: Total deposits grew from $1.1 billion in March to $4.6 billion by July, driven by clients in crypto, AI and defense.

items.title: Pokémon cards are becoming multibillion dollar market. Crypto wants to fix how they trade
items.description: Collectors are spending millions on trading cards, while blockchain startups are turning physical Pokémon cards into digital assets. The harder task is creating enough liquidity to compete with established marketplaces.

items.title: MoneyGram expands on Solana with global crypto-to-cash service

items.title: MoneyGram expands crypto cash ramps to Solana
items.description: MoneyGram’s Ramps service now connects Solana wallets and applications to its global cash network, with Rift becoming the first wallet to integrate the service.

items.title: Following Senate delay, crypto bill has a narrow window to become law
items.description: After an August recess, lawmakers in the Senate will have just 36 days in session before the end of the year to pass the CLARITY Act.

items.title: Strategy CEO says company will resume Bitcoin accumulation this year
items.description: The company has bought roughly 25 times more BTC than it has sold this year, despite recent sales that challenged its long-standing accumulation strategy.

items.title: ARP Digital secures Dubai VARA broker-dealer license
